summary: Iteration 13 verified: (1) Travel gallery no longer crops images — all 4 travel items render at natural aspect ratio (travel-item-2 Big Ben: natural AR 1.052 ≈ rendered AR 1.052, no crop, watermark area intact). (2) Contact form phone field is persisted end-to-end and email-on-submit works (Emergent email proxy returns 202 Accepted; backend logs 'Inquiry email sent'). (3) contact-email-direct mailto link points to bill@billfarrphotography.com with subject/body query params. (4) All regression flows (hero, prints inquire prefill, journal modal, validation, no Emergent badge, zero console errors) pass. 10/10 backend pytest cases pass including two new phone tests.

travel_images_no_crop.travel-item-2 (Big Ben): natural 1600x1521 AR=1.052  rendered 1151x1094 AR=1.052  ✓ (nearly square, no crop)

detailed_findings.form_validation: Empty submit shows 'Please fill in your name, email and message.' toast and does NOT POST ✓
detailed_findings.form_submit_e2e: Filled name+email+phone(+1-555-013-1313)+booking+message → success toast 'on its way to Bill' ✓; form cleared to empty for all fields including phone ✓
detailed_findings.phone_persistence: GET /api/inquiries newest entry matches submitted email and phone == '+1-555-013-1313' ✓
detailed_findings.email_send_backend_log: httpx POST https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send → 202 Accepted; 'Inquiry email sent to bill@billfarrphotography.com' logged for every POST
detailed_findings.prints_inquire_prefill: print-inquire-0 click sets contact-subject='Print inquiry — The Catch' and activates contact-type-print (bg-clay class) ✓
detailed_findings.journal_modal: Opens on journal-item-0 click, closes on Escape ✓

critical_code_review_comments: Nit (unchanged from iter12): success/error toast doesn't expose a data-testid — Playwright must fall back to text matching. Consider adding data-testid='contact-success' / 'contact-error' to Sonner toasts (functional behavior unaffected).

Nit: send_inquiry_email() is awaited inside the request handler — a slow email proxy (30s timeout) will delay the API response. If perceived latency ever becomes an issue, dispatch via BackgroundTasks.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ inquiries + one UI-submitted inquiry (email testui13_*@example.com, phone +1-555-013-1313) persisted to Mongo during this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 fully passes both the Travel image-crop fix and the email-on-submit + optional phone feature. Backend pytest suite now has 10 tests including phone persistence. Email delivery cannot be verified in an inbox — verified indirectly via backend logs showing 202 Accepted from the Emergent proxy. No regressions.
